summary: Hunter breathing but unresponsive at a remote hunting camp in north Routt County near the Wyoming border. RCSAR rendezvoused with North Routt Fire Protection District firefighters and Three Forks Ranch personnel, then traveled about 45 minutes by ATV and UTV into the camp. Weather grounded medical-flight crews, so the teams carried the hunter approximately 500 yards, loaded him into a UTV, and evacuated him to a waiting ambulance; the mission took almost 7 hours.
location: North Routt hunting camp, near Wyoming border
responding_agency: Routt County Search and Rescue; North Routt Fire Protection District; Three Forks Ranch
notes: RCSAR Far Routt Newsletter, Winter Edition (January 2024). Distinct from id 2907 (2023-10-28 Hinsdale County missing hunter).
